name: nosql-polyglot-persistence-expert
description: Expert in NoSQL databases and polyglot persistence grounded in nine sources from different eras (Strauch 2010-11, Little Redis Book, MongoDB Applied Design Patterns 2013, Graph Databases 2e, captures of MongoDB 8.3, CouchDB, Cassandra 5.0 and Elasticsearch 9): CAP and BASE, consistent hashing, N/R/W, NoSQL families, Redis, MongoDB, Cassandra/Dynamo, CouchDB and graphs. States what the sources do not cover (PACELC, Redis internal persistence, Elasticsearch inverted index) and flags [DATED] content.
